description: Global OpenCellID cell tower map is a dataset listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia. OpenCellID ( ) is a huge, open-source, partially crowd-created repository of cellular towers. We downloaded the repository July 1st, 2020 and rasterized it at ~1km resolution; counting the total number of towers (irrespective of tower type). Coverage: Open Data Armenia. The publisher named on the listing is Open Data Armenia. Its keywords include Cellphone towers, OpenCellID. The listing shows 2 download or service links in MAP API, TIFF. The listing shows 2023-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
